content.guideline: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
content.summary: Statement on review of relationships with healthcare industry, requirement for transparency and ethical integrity for experts developing ESC Guidelines.
content.mandatory_requirement: All experts involved in development of ESC Guidelines must comply with the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy and submit a yearly Declaration of Interests (DOI) during the writing and reviewing phases.
content.assessment_note: All DOIs presented in this report were assessed prior to work commencing and during guideline development, according to applicable review criteria defined in the ESC Declaration and Management of Conflict of Interest Policy, Annex 3.
content.policy_reference: The most up-to-date version of the policy and its annexes are available on the ESC website.
